page.notes: Doubtful readings: "lacte" (printed "laste") marked by reading only; "cofto" uncertain; "semimine" uncertain; "Vsu" (printed "Viu"/"Vsu") uncertain. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, including "sunt" (printed "funt") and "secundo" (printed "fecundo"). Left margin note "Cap.20." placed at the line where it stands.
